title: Single finite-level projection invertibility from normalized comparisons
statement: Fix ell, E and Base b as in def-sp-tower-shriek-data, Operations o, ComparisonLevels levels and StrictFiniteCoordinates coordinates satisfying StrictFiniteProjectionComparisons of def-sp-strict-compactification-comparison-interfaces. Let k be a finite-field datum with ell different from its characteristic, let f:X->Y be a morphism of separated finite-type k-schemes, and fix any compactification c of f. For one index n and bounded-below strict towers K,L, suppose their n-th levels have retained Origin witnesses and satisfy GoodLevel. Then comparisonLevelProjection at the evaluated K_n,L_n is an isomorphism in the finite coefficient derived category. Only one n is involved; the result makes no assertion about invertibility on the tower derived category.

proof.text: Use b.ideals n to transport the intrinsic GoodLevel predicates to the positive uniformizer-power quotient by the identity of the ring of integers. Through the exact canonical coefficient realization and the retained origin isomorphisms, transport cohomology support and constructibility to the fixed-scalar origins. Fully faithful site comparison reflects bounded constructibility of the bounded-below etale antecedents; comparison Tor amplitude (ii) reflects the Tor interval. The unequal residue characteristic makes ell invertible.

Apply the witnessed finite compact projection formula to the same compactification and these two antecedents. Its projection map is invertible. The equation in StrictFiniteProjectionComparisons transports its image through the canonical tensor, compact-support and pullback comparison isomorphisms to comparisonLevelProjection at the fixed-scalar realizations. Naturality transports along each retained Origin.realization; cancelling the isomorphisms gives the claim. This uses no conservativity on towers and requires no equations between witnesses at distinct levels.
